description: P0.3 adversarial merged-hook re-entry: a synthetic Dragon-typed Seviper (species 336 gives venom_strike in Gen3) attacks a Carvanha (species 318 gives rough_skin). The nonfatal main hit and dragon_first_double extra hit must each call defender whenAttacked (two 20%-max-HP Rough Skin recoils) and attacker afterAttack (two +2 Poison applications). Starting at 41/100 HP leaves the attacker at 1 HP after both hook pairs, then the reply ends the battle in one round. Final HP, poison stacks, rounds, and RNG distinguish missing, duplicated, or recursively re-entered hooks.
